Hi all,

My name is Jasper. I'm a student in New Media & Digital Culture at Utrecht University; I'm also a freelance video producer. I'm interested in Philosophy; the role of New Media technologies in human life; video production; audiovisual cultural heritage; electronic music production.

I'm relatively new here, after more and more places in cyberspace are being commodified - at the expense of a solid community with quality posts. With 'quality posts' I mean critical thinking about topics that matter, but are discarded by most of the general public. I'm disappointed by the fact that the majority of people doesn't want to think critically about the world we live in. At first I thought people were just plain stupid, but later on I figured people don't do critical thinking because it would make their lives miserable, meaningless and empty.

However, I think the internet is a great place where people can combine their rationality to discuss various topics. The internet has not become the utopian global place where everybody is heard, without central government. However, Voat comes close to this. In that sense, the internet is a place of issue networks and considering vision and view, Voat seems to be a good place to start.

It seems I'm a technology-optimist and internet-utopian, yes, however, I'm also a moderator of /v/dystopia - because human inventions and technology will eventually be our final destruction.

I invite you all to come and have a look at /v/dystopia, and contribute ideas about technology and human life.
